mkdir -p /home/user/dashboard && cd /home/user/dashboard && cat > build.py <<'EOF' import csv, collections from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('/home/user/uploads/sales_2026.csv'))) units=collections.OrderedDict(); prod=collections.defaultdict(float); reg=collections.defaultdict(float) for r in sorted(rows,key=lambda r:r['date']): u=int(r['units']); rev=u*float(r['unit_price']) units[r['date'][:7]]=units.get(r['date'][:7],0)+u prod[r['product']]+=rev; reg[r['region']]+=rev try: F=ImageFont.load_default(size=14); FT=ImageFont.load_default(size=18) except TypeError: F=FT=ImageFont.load_default() # line chart W,H=800,500; L,R,T,B=70,30,60,60 im=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(im) d.text((W//2,20),"Units sold per month (2026)",fill='black',font=FT,anchor='mm') months=list(units); vals=list(units.values()); mx=max(vals); top=((mx//5)+1)*5 d.line([(L,T),(L,H-B),(W-R,H-B)],fill='black',width=2) for i in range(0,top+1,5): y=H-B-(H-B-T)*i/top d.line([(L,y),(W-R,y)],fill='#dddddd'); d.text((L-8,y),str(i),fill='black',font=F,anchor='rm') pts=[] for i,(m,v) in enumerate(zip(months,vals)): x=L+(W-L-R)*(i+0.5)/len(months); y=H-B-(H-B-T)*v/top; pts.append((x,y)) d.text((x,H-B+15),m,fill='black',font=F,anchor='mm') d.line(pts,fill='#1f77b4',width=3) for (x,y),v in zip(pts,vals): d.ellipse([x-5,y-5,x+5,y+5],fill='#1f77b4'); d.text((x,y-15),str(v),fill='black',font=F,anchor='mm') im.save('units_per_month.png') # pie W,H=700,450; im=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(im) d.text((W//2,20),"Revenue share per product",fill='black',font=FT,anchor='mm') tot=sum(prod.values()); cols=['#1f77b4','#ff7f0e','#2ca02c','#d62728','#9467bd','#8c564b'] box=[40,60,400,420]; a=-90.0 for i,(p,v) in enumerate(sorted(prod.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1])): s=360*v/tot; d.pieslice(box,a,a+s,fill=cols[i%6],outline='white',width=2); a+=s y=150+i*40; d.rectangle([440,y,460,y+20],fill=cols[i%6]) d.text((470,y+10),f"{p}: {100*v/tot:.1f}% (${v:,.2f})",fill='black',font=F,anchor='lm') im.save('revenue_share.png') rt=''.join(f"{k}{v:,.2f}" for k,v in sorted(reg.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1])) open('index.html','w').write(f"""Sales 2026 Dashboard

Sales 2026 Dashboard

Units sold per month

Revenue share per product

Revenue per region

{rt}
RegionRevenue
Total{tot:,.2f}
""") print(units,dict(prod),dict(reg)) EOF python3 build.py nohup python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory /home/user/dashboard >server.log 2>&1 & sleep 1 for f in index.html units_per_month.png revenue_share.png; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$f %{http_code} %{content_type} %{size_download}\n" localhost:8000/$f; done

cd /home/user/dashboard; python3 -c "
from PIL import Image
for f in ['units_per_month.png','revenue_share.png']: print(f,Image.open(f).size)"
